MeteorField_Text_Npc0.en: A rock fell here. It was not a\nrock.
MeteorField_Text_Npc0.fr: Un rocher est tombé ici. Ce n'était\npas un rocher.

MeteorField_Text_Npc1.en: CLEFAIRY came from the stars. Or so\nthey say.
MeteorField_Text_Npc1.fr: MÉLOFÉE vient des étoiles. Du\nmoins c'est ce qu'on dit.

MeteorField_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

MeteorField_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
